The header mirrors the primary liquidation, utilizing the same puntoEmision and numeroOrden logic. However, the tipo\_reg field dictates to the schema parser that this payload represents an LSG, invoking a completely different set of validation rules.2

The main creation payload for grains automotor is `autorizarCPEAutomotor.solicitud`, which groups fields into `cabecera`, `origen`, `intervinientes`, `datosCarga`, `destino`, `destinatario`, `transporte` and `observaciones`.[^4][^13]

| `tipoActividadRepresentadoConsultar` | Activities the emisor/representado is registered for in RUOCA |

| `localidadXProvinciaConsultar` | Localities by province |
| `tipoOperacionXActividadConsultar` | Operation types per activity (01: Compra/Venta, 02: Consignación) |
